crossRefs.note: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son…
The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had…
Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

people.name: Josiah
people.line: King of Judah known for his religious reforms

people.name: Uzza
people.line: A garden where Manasseh and Amon were buried

translations.web: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: And he was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and his son Josiah reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
translations.asv: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
